newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 60.6 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 60.6 bln marks in tender at 3 pct rate.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday that it had awarded 60.6 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank accepted 25.40 percent of the bids for 13-day funds. A repo pact for 61 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net 400 million marks is draining from the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 238.4 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week.
